how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ahn-qiraj-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8556:obj:0: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in ⟦E1⟧. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8556:details:0: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.

rows.quest:8556:completion:0: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.
rows.quest:8557:obj:0: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in ⟦E1⟧. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8557:details:0: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, ⟦2⟧. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, ⟦3⟧.

rows.quest:8557:details:2: BI promise you won't be disappointed.
rows.quest:8557:completion:0: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
rows.quest:8557:completion:1: BTake this cloak, ⟦4⟧. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
rows.quest:8558:obj:0: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in ⟦E1⟧. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8558:details:0: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

rows.quest:8558:completion:1: BTake your weapon, ⟦7⟧. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!

After all, while he expects dragons at his doorstep, he is not prepared for someone like you.⟦9⟧⟦10⟧Just as Anachronos and Staghelm defeated the Qiraji a thousand years ago through the alliance of mortal and dragon races, we too shall form a pact. rows.quest:8801:obj:0: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Caelastrasz in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
rows.quest:8801:details:0: The walls of Ahn'Qiraj tremble. A force of evil, older than the world itself, has been destroyed.
rows.quest:8801:details:1: BAs you look at the remnants of the colossal abomination your heart nearly freezes. Even in death you can feel the legacy of C'Thun's evil around you.
rows.quest:8801:details:2: BYou have done what was thought to be impossible.
rows.quest:8801:details:3: BYou grab at an eye stalk of the fiend, stowing it safely in your pack.
rows.quest:8801:details:4: BTake the Eye of C'Thun to the dragons in the next chamber.
rows.quest:8801:completion:0: We will leave this place on our own, Lady ⟦67⟧ - once we are certain that the evil within has been wholly destroyed. Your journey of legend is almost at an end.
rows.quest:8802:obj:0: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
rows.quest:8802:details:0: To the Caverns of Time you go, ⟦68⟧ ⟦69⟧. Anachronos awaits your return. Give him the eye of C'Thun as he will undoubtedly wish to place it in his master's collection.⟦70⟧
rows.quest:8802:completion:0: The Master has left these for you, champion. From the timeless cache: A collection of artifacts spanning thousands of years - the choice is yours.
